title: unify-sdks-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.16.0
author: Maya Kapoor
description: Motivation: bring Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs into parity for auth token handling, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics; ship coordinated minor version bumps (v1.16.0) and update docs/examples. Changes unify the RetryPolicy interface, standardize auth token refresh/backoff behavior, improve streaming iterators/async readers for ergonomics, and include small perf fixes for buffer handling. This PR is intentionally cross-repo in scope (monorepo subpackages) to keep runtime and client behavior consistent across languages and avoid repeated regressions. Checklist: - [x] Implement unified RetryPolicy surface in Python/TS/Go - [x] Auth token refresh with exponential backoff + jitter and centralized metrics - [x] Streaming API ergonomic improvements (TS async iterator, Python context-manager generator, Go streaming Reader) - [x] Parity fixes for edge cases (cancellation, partial frames) - [x] Update SDK docs and migration notes - [x] Bump package versions to v1.16.0 and update changelogs Notes: initial CI run had a flaky integration test in the TypeScript streaming suite (race on socket close); test was stabilized and re-run. Backwards compatibility: default behavior stays the same for existing users, but advanced RetryPolicy hooks are now public to allow finer control. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and telemetry rollout. Migration: minimal for most users; see release_notes field below for callouts. Other references: RFC: /docs/design/sdk-retries-ergonomics.md, Linear ENG-1024.
commits: python: introduce RetryPolicy class and exports; implement exponential backoff token refresh
typescript: add async iterable streaming interface; stabilize close semantics; fix socket race (tests)
go: export RetryPolicy struct + helper for default backoff; streaming reader improvements
sdk-common: extract shared retry constants and telemetry hooks
docs: migration guide, examples for streaming and retry customization
chore: bump package versions to v1.16.0 across SDKs and update CHANGELOGs
review_comments: Ava Chen: Can we expose a small interface for custom jitter strategies? Suggest adding a JitterStrategy protocol in Python and a tiny helper in TS/Go.
Maya Kapoor (author): Good call, added a JitterStrategy protocol in python and exported a DefaultJitter helper in TS/Go. Kept default unchanged.
Diego Martinez: TypeScript tests flaked in CI (close.test). I ran locally and reproduced; fix looks good but please add a short integration test to assert no double-close path.
Maya Kapoor (author): Added extra integration assertion and a comment explaining the socket-close ordering; re-ran CI.
Priya Singh: Docs look great. One nit: update the migration note to call out behavior when users had custom retry wrappers.
Maya Kapoor (author): Expanded migration note with a short code snippet showing how to adapt custom wrappers.
release_notes:
- SDKs: v1.16.0 release (Python/TS/Go)
- Unify retry semantics across SDKs: new RetryPolicy API and default exponential backoff with jitter.
- Auth: safer token refresh with centralized metrics and fewer token race conditions.
- Streaming: ergonomic async iterator (TS), context-manager generator (Python), and Reader improvements (Go); fixes for socket-close/cancellation edge cases.
- Migration: most users are unaffected; if you implemented custom retry wrappers, consult docs/migration-v1.16.0.md for a short adaptation snippet.
review_summary: 4 reviewers, all comments addressed; one flaky test fixed; CI passed after stabilization. Production rollout scheduled with feature flags for telemetry-first monitoring.
notes: Coordinated minor release across SDKs to ensure parity for customers depending on consistent behavior across languages. Telemetry flags added so we can monitor token refresh error rates and retry counts post-rollout.
